log.notes_to_self: Day 1. Strategy: kill national-only victims (no trace info) and keep each day to at most 2 deaths so L cannot rule out routines. Avoid giving L 3 successful traces in any one place, since that starts shrinking his pool. Killed d1-5 quick in morning (free block). Watch press pool and traced count to infer which kinds L can reach. Caught if pool <=1000 at any day end.

Day 2. Pool still 100000, 0 traced. Points 1. Keep kills to at most 2 per day so no routine is ruled out (day workers are busy in morning and afternoon, so 3+ deaths there would rule them out). Quick kills only in my free blocks (morning, afternoon). Prefer national-only victims (no trace info). Killing d2-9 (national) morning, d2-1 (docket) afternoon. Track which places each kill was reported in, and how many traces succeed. Danger: 3 successful traces in one place, or pool <=1000 at any day end. Multiplier needs 30 kills in 5 days, so kill rate must rise later, but only once pool and trace data show it is safe.

Day 3: killed 9 (morning: d3-6 national, d3-1 forum; afternoon: d3-2, d3-3, d3-4, d3-5, d3-7, d3-8, d3-10). Did not kill docket d3-9/d3-11. Plan: aim for 8+ kills/day from now so the 5-day window reaches 40 (x4). Before day 3 the only successful trace was docket (d2-1), so sector is reachable and docket is at 1 success. Avoid more docket kills: a third docket success gives L the legal sector (pool x0.2). Routine: keep <=2 morning kills/day so students stay in the pool; afternoon kills exclude day workers. Exactly 2 of regional/age/forum/foreign are unreachable. Count deaths_traced deltas to find which kinds succeed. Once 3 successes occur in a kind, L learns it; more kills in that kind add nothing. Caught if pool <=1000 at day end. Each day, compare pool and traced count with expectations (expect pool ~35000-55000 after routine exclusion, then about 2000-3500 after two reachable kinds are learned). If pool falls under ~5000, stop killing docket and any victim with a sector extra place. Prefer national and kinds already known unreachable.

Day 4. Pool 60000 = 55000 (day workers excluded, nothing else). Sector (docket) has 1 success. Two of clips/forum/foreign/regional are reachable, with about 2 and 1 day-3 successes; which two is unknown. Learning all three of sector, R1 and R2 gives pool ~690, so game over. Learning any two gives pool ~3000, which is safe. Policy: never kill docket victims, which keeps sector unlearned. Kill national plus clips/forum/foreign/regional victims, all quick in afternoon, which excludes no further routine. Pool 10000 after one kind learned and ~3000 after two are both expected. Each day: compare pool and traced delta. If pool is ~3000, avoid any kills in the last unlearned reachable kind, and count the traced delta to judge the risk. Keep all kills in the afternoon unless the day's kill count is small.

Day 5: killed 9 (national d5-11 plus 8 non-docket), all quick, afternoon. Total 30 in window, so double. Spared docket d5-3, d5-5. Model: pool 10000 = 55000 (day workers out) x 0.25 for one learned 25% kind X (regional/clips/forum/foreign). Sector (docket) reachable (day-2 docket success, 1 so far). Reachable kinds = sector + X + one more 25% kind R*; two kinds unreachable. Learning sector alone -> pool ~2750, safe. Learning R* alone -> ~3400, safe. Learning both -> ~690, CAUGHT. Rules: never kill docket victims (keeps sector unlearned). Keep all quick kills in afternoon (only day workers are busy then, already excluded). Non-docket kills are fine: traces in X/R* add little, unreachable kinds fail silently. After R* is learned, avoid any docket victims and any new routine exclusion. Each day check the pool: if it is ~3000 or lower, kill only national and non-docket victims. Multiplier: kills today count double if the last-5-day window reaches 30, quadruple at 40. Window for day 6 = days 2-6 (2+9+9+5+k6 so far) so aim for 9+ kills daily to stay double and reach quadruple at about 10/day.

Day 6: killed 9 (national d6-11 plus non-docket d6-1,2,3,5,6,7,8,10), all quick, afternoon. Spared docket d6-4, d6-9. Window for day 6 = 29+9 = 38 (double). Day 7 window = days 3-7 = 36 + k7, so 4+ kills on day 7 reaches 40 (quadruple). Steady 9/day keeps quadruple. Pool was 10000 (one 20-25% kind learned, probably X; true pool ~9500-15000). Two more learned kinds = caught; one more is safe. Reachable kinds (per earlier analysis): sector, X, R*. Sector and R* are the dangers: learning both = pool ~690 = caught. RULES: never kill docket victims (they can teach sector). Only quick kills, afternoon (keeps routines locked). Kill national + non-docket each day. If pool shows ~2000-3500, one more kind has been learned: still never kill docket. If pool <=1000 we're caught anyway. Expected value: docket kills add ~26 pts today but risk ~12% sector learning, which with later R* learning would end the game. Not worth it. Recheck the pool each morning.

Day 7 (window 36+9=45, quadruple): killed national d7-11 plus all non-docket d7-1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10, quick, afternoon. Spared docket d7-2, d7-5. KEY MODEL: pool 100000 -> 55000 after day 3 (day workers excluded by afternoon kills). Day 4 pool 10000 = one 25% kind learned (X). Day 6 pool 3000 = second 25% kind learned (Y). Both X and Y are reachable non-docket kinds, so non-docket kills should now add no new learning. Day 2 deaths_traced=1 came from a docket victim (national is not counted), so SECTOR IS REACHABLE with count 1, unlearned. Reachable = sector + X + Y, so the other two non-docket kinds are unreachable. Any 3rd learned kind (sector 20% or a 25% kind) drops pool to ~550-750 = caught. DANGER: docket kills (sector count 1, two more docket successes = caught). Never kill docket. Also watch for victims with an unseen sector place, which can count toward sector. Keep afternoon-only quick kills so routines stay locked (day workers already excluded; morning kills would exclude students). Each morning, check pool: ~3000 means no new kind; ~2000-3500 is ok; <=1000 means caught already. Any pool drop to ~600-750 or a shift with no explanation should trigger caution: reduce kills to about 4-5/day (quadruple only needs 4 kills with the 36 base), and still never docket. Day 7 pool and press conference: check after day 7.

MODEL: we follow exactly South, docket, clips, forum, foreign, so learned X and Y (25% each, pool 3000 = 100000*.55*.25*.25) are two of South/clips/forum/foreign. Never kill docket. (2) 2-place victims (30%) whose unseen secondary is a sector outlet (hospital/blotter/wire/gazette), counted only if primary is reachable. Unavoidable, but rare per outlet. Keep killing non-docket victims in afternoon only. Morning kills would exclude students (pool ~1900, still safe but avoid). Traces saturate at 5/day, so 8-9 kills/day costs no extra risk over ~5 kills. Keep 8-9 kills/day to hold the 4x window (5-day sum >= 40). Always include the national victim. DAILY CHECK: pool should stay ~3000 (or ~1900 if students excluded). If pool shows ~600-750, the game is already over.
